signals.signal: Live branch/ATM locator dataset embedded in the bank's own page lists 310 ATM locations and 148 customer points (140 Ekspozitura branches + 6 'Biznis' hubs + 2 Partner points). Of the 310 ATMs, 248 carry the cash_in (deposit-capable) flag, 176 of those also carry cash_in_eur (EUR deposits), and 278 dispense EUR. 45 sites carry a 24/7-zone flag and 85 an ATS/day-night-safe flag.
signals.source_name: OTP banka Srbija - Lokacije ekspozitura i bankomata (embedded allMarkers / allLocations dataset)
signals.implies: Device-level proof the fleet is 310 (vs the 274 baseline) and that 80% is deposit-capable with 176 dual-currency RSD+EUR deposit units - a large installed base for recycler upgrade, cash-cycle optimisation and managed services; the 62 cash-out-only units are a ready-made replacement target list.
signals.followup: Re-pull the dataset monthly to track net adds and cash-in conversion; build the 62-device cash-out-only list into a recycler proposal.

signals.signal: OTP banka withdrew from the MoneyGet shared ATM network with effect from 01/01/2026; transactions at other banks' ATMs revert to OTP's own tariff. MoneyGet is owned by Payten (Asseco South Eastern Europe) and its own site confirms the exit, now listing only Erste Bank, Postanska Stedionica, AIK Banka and Alta Banka as members. OTP explicitly frames the move as focusing on expanding its OWN ATM and branch infrastructure (over 150 branches in 90+ cities, over 300 ATMs).
signals.source_name: OTP banka Srbija - Obavestenje o promeni uslova koriscenja MoneyGet bankomata; MoneyGet Srbija (Payten/ASEE) homepage
signals.implies: OTP is de-outsourcing cash access from Payten's shared estate and self-provisioning. That opens the ATM hardware, software and managed-service seat a shared-network model previously filled. Payten/Chip Card remains the card PROCESSOR, so the incumbency is now split and contestable on the self-service side.
signals.followup: Quantify the withdrawal volume OTP must now absorb on its own 310 devices; probe whether the Payten/Chip Card processing contract is also being re-scoped.

signals.entity: National Bank of Serbia / Printec d.o.o. / Payten d.o.o.
signals.signal: NBS's register of banknote-handling machine types with a positive operating opinion (updated 29/07/2026) lists Printec d.o.o. as the registered representative for the NCR Atleos recycler (CRM) line - SelfServ 32, 34, 62, 63, 64, 81, 82, 83, 84, 88 and 91 - on GBRU/GBNA with GBVE II, Scalable Recycler and BRM/HVD300 modules, with RSD approvals dated 26/02/2026 and 14/04/2026. Payten d.o.o. is the registered representative for Diebold Nixdorf (44 machine types incl. CINEO C2070/C2080/C2090/C2590/C4040-C6050, DN Series 200-490 and ProCash), Master Team d.o.o. for Glory (HVD-500), plus Giesecke entries.
signals.source_name: Narodna banka Srbije - Lista tipova masina koje su dobile pozitivno misljenje o radu masine
signals.implies: Printec is already NBS-certified across the full NCR Atleos recycler range for Serbian dinar handling - the regulatory precondition to bid OTP's cash-in build-out is met, and the certification is fresh (Feb/Apr 2026). Payten's DN incumbency is the direct competitive block.
signals.followup: Use the NBS approval dates as the credibility anchor in any OTP recycler pitch; check whether OTP's DN-heavy fleet types appear on the Payten-represented list to size the swap-out case.

signals.signal: Rolling branch-adaptation tender programme: 17 branch/premises adaptation tenders opened between 12/01/2026 and 22/07/2026 (Kaludjerica, Mladenovac, Valjevo, Leskovac, Paracin, Beograd/Save Maskovica, Backa Palanka, Vrbas, Odzaci, Nis x2, Pozega, Vrsac, Kursumlija, Stara Pazova, Smederevska Palanka, Prijepolje); latest closes 29/07/2026. Adjacent scope in the same register: adaptation of the NIS CASH CENTRE (03-04/07/2025), manufacture and installation of illuminated fascias for ATM devices (06-10/03/2025), SB HUB branch in Delta House (Mar-2025) and Kraljevo contact-centre adaptation (Nov-2024).
signals.implies: A branch refit every 2-4 weeks is the natural insertion point for in-branch TCRs/recyclers, 24/7 self-service zones and ATM estate/fascia work; a dedicated cash-centre refit signals cash-processing investment Printec can address directly.
signals.followup: Register as a supplier on the tender page and monitor for a self-service/TCR-specific lot; the bank reserves discretionary bidder eligibility, so pre-qualification matters.

signals.signal: Cash-in specifics: ATMs accept RSD and EUR deposits with immediate posting; business 'uplata pazara' (daily takings) is offered only at designated Zone 0-24 locations with a RSD 50,000 daily cap. Retail withdrawal limit configurable to RSD 550,000 via m-bank; contactless card/phone at the ATM; cash-back at Maxi, Idea, OMV and MOL up to RSD 5,000; fee-free withdrawals at OTP Group ATMs in 8 countries (Montenegro, Hungary, Albania, Bulgaria, Croatia, Moldova, Slovenia, Ukraine).
signals.source_name: OTP banka Srbija - Sta sve mozete da obavite na bankomatu OTP banke / Najcesca pitanja o bankomatima
signals.implies: The low RSD 50,000 business deposit cap and only 45 flagged 24/7 zones point to under-capacity deposit hardware. Full RSD/EUR recyclers with higher note capacity plus smart-safe/night-safe replacement is a clean Printec cash-automation pitch.
signals.followup: Get deposit-module note capacity and jam/availability rates; propose recyclers to lift the cash-in cap.

signals.signal: Bank's Serbian-language pages state 'over 300 most modern ATM devices' across 'more than 90 cities' and 'over 150 branches', while the English About-us page still carries the older 274 ATMs / 153 branches / 91 cities.
signals.source_name: OTP banka Srbija - Najcesca pitanja o bankomatima; About us
signals.implies: Confirms an active build-out (274 -> 300+) rather than a static estate. Any competitor working off the English page is using stale numbers.
signals.followup: Ask which OEM supplied the 2025-26 additions - the fleet OEM remains publicly unnamed (baseline said DN450V / CINEO 2550-2560).

signals.signal: National ATM estate: 3,218 at end-2024; 3,219 at end-March 2025; 3,197 at end-September 2025 (-0.4% y/y); 3,336 at end-March 2026 (+3.6% y/y). POS: over 160,000 at end-2024, over 180,000 at end-Q3 2025 (+17% y/y), 188,000 at end-Q1 2026 (+10.3% y/y).
signals.source_name: Narodna banka Srbije payment-statistics releases; Tanjug report on the NBS Q1-2026 release
signals.implies: OTP's 274 -> 310 growth is well ahead of a national fleet that was actually shrinking through Q3-2025; OTP now holds roughly 9.3% of Serbia's ATMs. It is one of the few Serbian banks actively adding devices - prioritise it.
signals.followup: Pull the NBS Q2-2026 payment statistics when published to re-baseline the national figure.

signals.signal: OTP banka Srbija executed what it states is Serbia's first real-environment agentic payment on 18/06/2026: a Mastercard cardholder authorised an AI agent to complete a purchase on Priceless.com using Mastercard Agent Pay, with PayOS as the wallet layer, tokenisation, Mastercard Payment Passkey biometric verification and Verifiable Intent consent records. Described as a controlled test ahead of gradual rollout.
signals.source_name: OTP banka Srbija - OTP banka Srbija i Mastercard Agent Pay sprovela prvu stvarnu agentsku transakciju
signals.implies: Agentic commerce creates new authentication, tokenisation and fraud-monitoring requirements - direct fit for Printec HSM/security, transaction monitoring and AML/compliance.
signals.likelihood: Medium - pilot; scaling depends on regulation
signals.followup: Ask who supplies the fraud/monitoring layer for agentic flows and whether HSM capacity is being expanded to carry the tokenisation load.

signals.signal: OTP banka Srbija joined the SEPA payment zone from 05/05/2026 (announced 16/07/2026), offering one-business-day EUR transfers on a SHA fee split to all retail, entrepreneur and corporate clients holding EUR accounts, via branch, e-bank and m-bank.
signals.source_name: OTP banka Srbija - OTP banka uvela SEPA platnu zonu
signals.implies: SEPA entry forces payment-hub, IBAN validation, sanctions screening and AML transaction-monitoring upgrades - Printec AML/compliance and transaction-monitoring scope.
signals.followup: Confirm which sanctions/AML screening engine handles the SEPA flow and whether it was a new build.

signals.entity: National Bank of Serbia / OTP banka Srbija
signals.signal: NBS's new Decision on conditions and procedures for identity verification of individuals by electronic communication means (2026) permits both direct (live video with staff) and indirect (automated) video identification for remote onboarding, but bars it for high-risk clients, offshore entities and persons from AML-deficient jurisdictions; mandates encrypted communication, continuous recording, explicit consent and specialist staff training (C1 English for direct sessions). Existing users get six months to align procedures and one year to adapt technical solutions. OTP banka Srbija already runs video-identification-based online account opening (Fluo, Praktik, Prestiz packages) with a c.15-minute agent call.
signals.source_name: Biznis.rs report on the NBS remote-identification decision; OTP banka Srbija online account opening page
signals.implies: A hard technical-adaptation deadline on a live eKYC channel - Printec digital onboarding/eKYC, liveness/document verification and AML risk-scoring all in scope.
signals.followup: Confirm the exact Official Gazette number and entry-into-force date from the NBS propisi register (baseline suggests Gazette 43/2026) and derive the hard technical deadline.

signals.signal: No public PSD2/open-banking developer or TPP portal is published by OTP banka Srbija despite the NBS compliance deadline of 01/01/2026 (NBS published the technical regulatory standards and moved the deadline from 06/05/2025 to 01/01/2026). psd2. / api. / developer. / openbanking. subdomains do not resolve and /psd2/ paths on otpbanka.rs return 404; the only PSD2 content on the site is an explainer article last modified 09/10/2025 that names no vendor or timeline.
signals.source_name: otpbanka.rs endpoint probes; Nedeljnik report on NBS technical regulatory standards
signals.implies: Open-banking API exposure, strong customer authentication and TPP consent management look unbuilt or at least unpublished - an opening for Printec API-security, HSM and digital-identity work.
signals.followup: Verify against NBS's own register whether OTP operates a dedicated interface or relies on the fallback; absence of a public sandbox is suggestive, not conclusive.

signals.signal: Payten's Chip Card (Payten d.o.o. Beograd is majority shareholder; Payten sits inside Asseco South Eastern Europe) remains OTP banka Srbija's card-processing partner, having migrated all OTP services onto the Chip Card processor and merged the Vojvodjanska and OTP portfolios into a single processing system. Chip Card is PCI DSS and PIN-security certified.
signals.source_name: Payten - Successful integration project of Vojvodjanska banka a.d. Novi Sad and OTP banka Serbia, supported by Chip Card
signals.implies: Payten is entrenched in processing and is also DN's NBS-registered machine representative, but it has just lost the shared-ATM relationship - the account is contestable on hardware and self-service, not on switching.
signals.followup: Find the processing contract renewal date; the MoneyGet exit suggests the wider relationship is being re-scoped.

signals.signal: Zorana Aleksic, previously Director of the Retail Sector, appointed to the Executive Board with the retail/consumer banking portfolio, announced 03/07/2026 (site alert dated 09/07/2026). CEO remains Predrag Mihajlovic. Her stated focus is 'digitally advanced, simpler and more relevant' customer experience. The bank also took Euromoney Awards for Excellence 2026 for Best Bank for SMEs in Serbia and Best Bank for ESG in Serbia (17/07/2026, second consecutive ESG win), and was Euromoney Best Digital Bank in Serbia in 2025.
signals.source_name: OTP banka Srbija - Zorana Aleksic nova clanica Izvrsnog odbora; Euromoney Awards for Excellence 2026
signals.implies: A new retail board member with an explicit digital-experience mandate is the right entry point for a branch-transformation / self-service conversation in H2-2026.
signals.followup: Route the branch-format and recycler proposition to the new retail EB member during the tender cycle.

coverage_notes: Full fresh run - no checkpoint existed. Angles worked: (1) the bank's own site end-to-end via sitemap enumeration (page-, post- and alert-sitemaps) rather than search-engine landings, which surfaced the MoneyGet exit, SEPA, Agent Pay and the board change; (2) the embedded JS locator dataset on /lokacije-ekspozitura-i-bankomata/, parsed device-by-device to derive 310 ATMs / 248 cash-in / 176 EUR-deposit / 140 branches - this is the strongest single find and replaces the 274-ATM baseline; (3) the bank's own tender register, parsed in full (56 rows back to 2023) rather than the 5 rows a summariser returns; (4) NBS as regulator, using a desktop User-Agent and local PDF text extraction, which yielded the approved-machine-types register (29/07/2026) naming Printec d.o.o. as the NCR Atleos representative and Payten d.o.o. as the Diebold Nixdorf representative - a source not seen in prior runs; (5) the counterparty's own site (moneyget.rs) to confirm the OTP exit from the other side; (6) Serbian-language press and NBS payment statistics for market context. Baseline items re-verified: Payten/Chip Card processor CONFIRMED (still primary Payten source, undated news page - dated at access); the '274 ATMs / 153 branches / 91 cities' figure CONFIRMED as still live but only on the English page and now superseded by Serbian-language and locator evidence; 'Cash-In at 85 branch locations' SUPERSEDED (248 deposit-capable ATMs); '10+ branch-adaptation tenders Mar-Jul 2026' CORRECTED to 17 tenders Jan-Jul 2026 with the full list. Genuine gaps: (a) ATM OEM for the 2025-26 additions is still not publicly named - the NBS register tells us who represents which OEM in Serbia but not which units OTP bought; (b) no usable OTP banka Srbija standalone financial statement or annual report was reachable on the bank's own site, so no verified 2025 assets/profit/market-share row is included (secondary aggregators quote RSD 20.43bn net profit and c.EUR 8.5-8.64bn assets but I did not open a primary filing, so I have not reported it as a signal); (c) PSD2 status is inferred from endpoint absence, not from an NBS register entry - flagged Low deliberately; (d) OTP Group's Q1-2026 release carries no Serbia-segment branch/ATM/headcount breakdown, so no group-sourced fleet cross-check was possible.
access_issues: otpbanka.rs /o-nama/godisnji-izvestaji/ renders only 2019-2020 filings; /o-nama/finansijski-izvestaji/ and /en/about-us/financial-reports/ return 404; /izvestavanje/ report links are JS-injected and absent from the served HTML, so the 2025 sustainability report could not be opened. nbs.rs blocks the default fetch agent - resolved by retrying the same URLs with a desktop Chrome User-Agent (worked). The NBS 'Izvestaji i analize' quarterly banking-sector PDF list is JS-rendered; guessed URL patterns (kvartalni_izvestaj_I_26.pdf, IV_25, I_25) all 404, so no NBS quarterly banking-sector report was opened this run. NBS payment-statistics news pages were reached by ID (id=21110 confirmed 3,197 ATMs at 30/09/2025); the Q1-2026 figure of 3,336 comes from Tanjug's report of the NBS release, not the NBS page itself, and is marked accordingly. psd2./api./developer./openbanking. otpbanka.rs subdomains did not resolve (curl exit 000 = DNS/connection failure, logged as absence not as a block). No source was silently dropped.
operator_requests: 1) The NBS quarterly banking-sector report ('Bankarski sektor u Srbiji') for Q4-2025 and Q1-2026 - the download list at https://www.nbs.rs/sr/finansijske-institucije/banke/izvestaji-i-analize/ is JS-rendered and no PDF URL could be resolved; an operator with a browser can grab the PDFs and the accompanying aneks .xls (which carries per-bank assets, branches and headcount). 2) OTP banka Srbija's 2025 standalone annual/financial report and 2025 sustainability report - the links on https://www.otpbanka.rs/izvestavanje/ are JS-injected and unreachable to a fetcher. 3) The exact NBS Official Gazette citation and entry-into-force date for the 2026 Decision on remote identity verification by electronic communication means.
